content.title: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments

content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Payment gateway

No-KYC payment gateways eliminate the need for Know Your Customer verification, allowing digital sellers to operate without the bureaucratic hurdles imposed by conventional payment systems. This architecture not only simplifies the payment process but also enhances privacy and security for both sellers and buyers. By leveraging blockchain technology and cryptocurrency, sellers can bypass the high fees and restrictions of platforms like Gumroad, which often charge as much as 10% on sales. This matters because it creates a more equitable landscape for creators who can now retain a larger portion of their earnings.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

At the core of no-KYC payment gateways lies a robust infrastructure that integrates various technologies to streamline transactions. For example, NOWPayments facilitates automatic crypto payment processing with minimal fees, charging only 0.5% per transaction. Meanwhile, platforms like Cloudflare Workers and Google Apps Script handle backend logic, ensuring seamless delivery of digital products. The combination of these tools allows for instantaneous payment confirmations and file delivery, thus creating a fluid experience for customers. The architecture is not a mere workaround; it is a complete sovereign stack that empowers creators with full control and ownership.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This infrastructure is specifically designed for digital creators in countries where conventional payment platforms impose restrictions, such as Nigeria, Ghana, and Kenya. These creators sell a variety of digital products, including ebooks, courses, and software, but often find themselves unable to collect payments effectively. By utilizing a no-KYC payment gateway, they can sell their products without the risk of being barred from essential services. This architecture serves as a lifeline, enabling creators to monetize their work while keeping their earnings intact and their customer data secure.
Retain 99.5% of your earnings by avoiding high platform fees.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The no-KYC payment gateway operates through a carefully orchestrated set of components that collaborate seamlessly. First, it uses a crypto payment processor like NOWPayments to handle transactions in various cryptocurrencies, ensuring low fees and no KYC requirements. Next, it relies on hosting solutions like GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for product delivery, which allows for instant access to digital goods after purchase. Additionally, backend logic is managed through Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers, storing orders securely in Supabase or Google Sheets. This integrated approach not only simplifies the user experience but also reinforces the creator's sovereignty over their digital marketplace.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To start deploying your no-KYC payment gateway, begin by choosing your preferred hosting and backend solutions, such as GitHub Pages and Google Apps Script. Next, set up an account with NOWPayments to manage your cryptocurrency transactions. Load your digital products into your chosen storage solution, like Supabase or Google Drive, ensuring easy access for buyers. Finally, integrate the payment processor with your store to enable automatic payment confirmations and delivery. By following these steps, you will have a fully operational digital storefront in no time.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

You can sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe by using a no-KYC payment gateway. This involves setting up a digital store that accepts cryptocurrency payments directly, eliminating the need for traditional payment processors. Tools like NOWPayments allow you to receive payments in various cryptocurrencies, ensuring you can monetize your content without restriction.
Instant delivery of digital products enhances customer satisfaction.

Visit https://coremerch.github.io/products.html for immediate access.
Your Deployment Checklist

Prepare your product files in delivery-ready format — PDF for ebooks, ZIP archives for multi-file products, exported files for Notion templates, OTF and TTF archives for font families. Set your prices in USD and let NOWPayments handle the crypto equivalent calculation automatically at transaction time. Deploy your stack and configure the product list with file paths, USD prices, and delivery settings. Configure your storefront with product pages and checkout flow. Test the checkout on both desktop and mobile — confirm QR codes generate correctly and live price feeds display accurately. Complete a real mainnet test transaction and confirm the delivery email arrives with a working download link. Check your order database and confirm the test transaction appears with all correct fields.
Frequently Asked Questions
How do I set up a no-KYC payment gateway?

Start by selecting a hosting solution like GitHub Pages. Then, create an account with NOWPayments for transaction processing. Load your products into a storage service and integrate the payment processor to enable automatic payments.
What cryptocurrencies can I use for my payments?
NOWPayments supports over 300 cryptocurrencies, allowing you to choose the ones that best suit your needs. Major options include Bitcoin, Ethereum, and USDT, ensuring flexibility for your customers.
What are the fees associated with using a no-KYC payment gateway?
NOWPayments charges a minimal fee of 0.5% per transaction, significantly lower than platforms like Gumroad, which can take up to 10%. This fee structure allows you to retain more of your earnings.
How can I ensure my digital products are delivered instantly?

Utilizing backend solutions like Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers ensures that product delivery is automated upon payment confirmation. This setup guarantees that customers receive their digital goods immediately.
Is there any support available after deployment?
Depending on the stack you choose, support options may vary. For instance, the Sovereign Starter Stack comes with 30-day support to assist with any deployment issues you may encounter.
